# Vishnu Kadaba

> Vishnu Kadaba's personal website

## About

Vishnu Kadaba is a software engineer based in Los Angeles studying computer science and computer engineering at the University of Southern California on a full scholarship.

He builds applied AI, machine learning, and full-stack products, with experience spanning AI agents, large language models, model evaluation, observability, retrieval systems, data infrastructure, and cloud engineering.

His projects include developer tools, in-application automation, multimodal collaboration software, computer vision systems, and multi-agent platforms recognized at national hackathons and startup programs.

## Experience

### Google - Engineering, AI Mode (Summer 2026)

Google AI Mode is an AI-powered Search experience for complex questions, multimodal inputs, follow-ups, and web-grounded answers. Vishnu worked on personalized finance and credit-card experiences within Google AI Mode.

### Lemma - Founding Engineer, Platform + AI (2025 - 2026)

Lemma provides production monitoring and observability for AI agents by capturing structured traces across model calls, tools, retrieval, and application logic. Its platform detects recurring failures, supports debugging and incident analysis, and turns resolved issues into continuous online evaluations. Vishnu contributed to agent observability, evaluation infrastructure, distributed tracing, and platform reliability as a founding engineer.

### Expedia Group - Engineering, Applied AI & ML (Summer 2025)

Expedia Group operates a global travel marketplace connecting travelers, partners, and advertisers through brands including Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. Its technology platform applies travel data and artificial intelligence to support personalized discovery, booking, advertising, and partner services. Vishnu worked on applied AI, machine learning, model evaluation, and advertising decision systems.

### Vellum - Engineering, Applied AI (2024 - 2025)

Vellum builds a persistent personal AI assistant that can remember context and perform actions across email, calendars, browsers, files, and business tools. The assistant works across web, desktop, mobile, messaging, and terminal interfaces with user-controlled permissions. Vishnu contributed applied AI engineering across document ingestion, retrieval, caching, and customer-support workflows.

### TRBHI - Engineering, Applied AI (2024)

TRBHI is a technology services company specializing in digital transformation, cloud engineering, platform engineering, artificial intelligence, and custom software development. It designs, implements, and maintains business systems for clients, including solutions in regulated industries such as healthcare. Vishnu developed scalable, retrieval-augmented public-information experiences in cloud environments.

### Ushur - Engineering, AI Labs (Summer 2024)

Ushur provides an enterprise agentic AI platform for automating customer experiences across healthcare, insurance, and financial services. Its governed AI agents support compliant inbound and outbound engagement across SMS, email, voice, and web channels. Vishnu worked in AI Labs on enterprise conversational AI and customer experience automation.
